name: komdosh-dev-spring-core
description: Must-have foundation for Kotlin + Spring WebFlux/coroutines services. Ships 15 agents, 10 slash commands, 9 mandatory skills, 11 rule documents, and 2 hooks — enforcing hexagonal architecture, coroutine safety, RFC 9457 error semantics, application-layer PII handling (no raw personal data in logs/traces/events; mask at the boundary; build erasure/access in), and the persistence/observability/testing conventions every consumer service needs. Other capabilities (events, QA artifact generation, vendor-decoupling, dep upgrader, flake detector) ship as separate plugins in the same marketplace.
